errors.evidence: The description states that Vanilla reaches approximately 2.50 loss near 1.2×10⁹ TFLOPs, but the figure shows it at approximately 2.51.
The description indicates that SepLLM reaches approximately 2.48 loss at 1.2×10⁹ TFLOPs, whereas it is around 2.50 in the figure.
The description omits the mention of the downward-pointing triangle markers for the Vanilla model and does not describe the presence of major gridlines on the y-axis.
The description does not adequately convey that the purpose of the plot is to compare loss values between the two models at different computation costs.
The description does not specify that the scale type for both axes is linear.
